title: T26: portrait_to_pack — standard orb packs from a portrait in code
head: t26-portrait-sprite-test
body:
`avatars/tools/portrait_to_pack.py`: turns one transparent portrait into a standard orb pack in plain code (decision #200). Used to build the 44 standard packs of avatar round one; the packs themselves stay out of git and ship through the signed library.

## What
- Crop, scale, palette-quantise, binary alpha, outline and rim; status brooch in Beacon's tones; props per state.
- Idle: slow 2-frame breathe (1 px shoulder rise). Blink on every awake state. Small head tilt on asking.
- No image model, no credits. Output passes `validate_pack` unchanged (all 44 round-one packs: 0 failures, largest sheet 108 KB).
- Tests on a synthetic portrait: exact 1 px rise, blink confined to the eye boxes, tilt leaves the body untouched, silhouette unbroken, CLI help.

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check
No ask-first gate or state mapping: a build-time image tool that runs on the builder's machine, not in the product.
